text:
Riya (Billing): FYI we received a $48,000 credit on INV-2024-1102 from PartnerCo. Invoice was for a 24-month agreement (2024-11-01 to 2026-10-31). Original amount $480,000. Credit language: "billing reconciliation credit for overcharge on hosting services". Close this Tue — need accounting treatment guidance. :thinking:
Jonas (Accounting): Quick facts pls: how was the contract originally allocated between hosting vs professional services?
Riya (Billing): Split on invoice: Hosting = $400,000 (deferred over 24 months), One-time onboarding services = $80,000 (recognized on delivery). Credit is applied to the invoice that included both line items but vendor note references hosting.
Liam (FP&A): So credit is 10% of total. If credit truly only affects hosting, it would reduce the hosting transaction price. If it relates to the whole contract, we adjust total transaction price and reallocate to POBs. Need to confirm intent.
Jonas (Accounting): Also confirm how much of hosting revenue has been recognized so far. That determines whether this is a prior-period correction vs prospective adjustment.
Riya (Billing): Recognized hosting through 2025-02 (4 months recognized out of 24). Hosting monthly = 400k/24 = 16,666.67. So recognized portion of the credit if allocated to hosting = 4 * 16,666.67 * 10% = 6,666.67 recognized already; remaining 41,333.33 remaining deferred.
Priya Controller: Vendor wording says "overcharge on hosting services" — that points to reducing the hosting consideration specifically. Given recognized portion exists, auditor likely treats the recognized portion as prior-period error requiring disclosure. We should loop in Audit.
AuditBot: Please attach vendor email and the original invoice PDF. Audit needs sampling and wording for position.
Riya (Billing): Uploading vendor_email.pdf and INV-2024-1102.pdf to the thread now.
Liam (FP&A): For month close, recommended interim treatment: move the full credit amount into a suspense clearing so we don't inadvertently change recognized revenue before CFO/audit signoff. Proposed interim JE:
```
DR 2400 Deferred Revenue              48,000
CR 9999 Suspense Clearing             48,000
```
This keeps the GL tidy pending final decision.
Jonas (Accounting): If final decision is to reduce hosting consideration (and treat recognized portion as prior-period), final JEs (after approvals) could be split: reverse recognized revenue portion and adjust deferred for unrecognized portion. Example final JEs if approved:
```
DR 4000 Revenue - Hosting             6,666.67
CR 2100 Accounts Payable / Cash       6,666.67   (or DR 2400 if reversing deferred first)

DR 2400 Deferred Revenue             41,333.33
CR 4000 Revenue - Hosting            41,333.33
```
(Exact accounts for cash/AP vs revenue reversal subject to policy and audit).
Priya Controller: Correct. But do NOT post revenue-reducing JEs before CFO + Audit alignment. Prepare a short restatement memo showing monthly P&L impact and whether correction meets the threshold for disclosure. Also tag tax — there may be VAT/GST adjustments.
Liam (FP&A): I'll draft the memo with monthly P&L bridge and attach the amortization schedule. If audit requires, we may need to restate the prior quarter.
Jonas (Accounting): Alternative view: if vendor confirms credit is for future hosting pricing concession (prospective), then adjust remaining deferred revenue only (no prior-period correction). So vendor confirmation language matters.
Riya (Billing): I'll ask PartnerCo to confirm whether credit is corrective for prior overbilling or a prospective concession. I'll push for explicit wording.
AuditBot: Also include customer communication if any — auditors like evidence that customer accounting impact matches billing intent.
Liam (FP&A): For close planning, if CFO cannot sign before cutoff, let's park the entire credit in suspense (as above). Once approved, we'll post the split JEs and include the memo in the close pack.
Priya Controller: Agreed. Tagging @CFO and @Tax. Audit team: please review once memo uploaded.
revbot: Reminder: month-end cutoff 2026-01-31 17:00 UTC. Any JEs after cutoff require CFO sign-off and documented rationale.
Riya (Billing): Thanks folks — I'll update with vendor response. :thumbsup:
